name: qrcake
description: Create and manage dynamic QR codes — repoint destinations and read scan analytics from a conversation.
long_description:
QR Cake makes **dynamic QR codes**: the printed code never changes, but you can repoint where it leads at any time.

With this extension Claude can:

- Create a dynamic QR code for any URL, with optional name and colours
- List your codes and see where each one points
- **Change a code's destination** without reprinting it
- Show scan analytics: scans per day, countries, and devices (plans with analytics)
- Check your plan usage and limits

You'll need a free QR Cake account and an API key from the dashboard (Dashboard → API Keys).

api_key.title: QR Cake API key
api_key.description: Create one at qrcake.com → Dashboard → API Keys. The key scopes every action to your account.
